ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD screening of all shareholders, directors, UBOs and authorized signatories against: (i) Taiwan's terrorist-designation lists implemented under the Terrorism Financing Prevention Act; (ii) FSC PEP definitions and high-risk jurisdiction lists; (iii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions and, as cross-border best practice for correspondent banking, the OFAC SDN List. PEPs must undergo enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth review, senior management approval and ongoing transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: MOEA Company Registration and Pre-Approval System (公司名稱暨所營事業預查), Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be in Traditional Chinese characters and be composed in accordance with MOEA's Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Rules. A separate English company name may be reserved if it is derived from or corresponds to the Chinese name; simplified-Chinese characters are not accepted for the statutory name. The name must not mislead the public or create identity/similarity with an existing registered company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 15 days of a rejection notice, the applicant may submit a written re-examination application to MOEA through the pre-approval portal, accompanied by amended name choices if appropriate. If re-examination is refused, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within the statutory appeal period, followed by judicial review in the Taipei High Administrative Court. Parallel filing of a new name pre-approval is permitted without prejudice to the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for a licensed retail securities broker. The FSC requires a dedicated physical registered office in Taiwan where books, records, client money segregation evidence and risk-management personnel are present; a co-working or serviced office may be accepted only if a dedicated exclusive lease and secure records storage exist.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (approximately 70% annual probability for a newly licensed retail broker; FSC conducts both scheduled and unannounced AML/compliance inspections).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act of Taiwan (公司法), Articles 5, 128-167 and 387; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals (外國人投資條例), Articles 7 and 10; Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例), Article 73; Securities and Exchange Act (證券交易法), Article 44; Standards Governing the Establishment of Securities Firms (證券商設置標準)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Company registry: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部商業署); foreign and cross-strait capital screening: Investment Commission, MOEA (經濟部投資審議司); securities brokerage licensing: Securities and Futures Bureau, Financial Supervisory Commission (金融監督管理委員會證券期貨局)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Company Registration (公司登記證明書) and, upon licensing, the FSC Securities Firm Operating Permit (證券商許可證照)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under the Companies Act, no general statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to a company limited by shares; however, the FSC requires a licensed securities broker (證券經紀商) to maintain paid-in capital of at least NT$200 million (approximately US$6.3 million), fully paid in cash into a dedicated capital account at a Taiwanese bank, verified by a licensed CPA capital-verification report. Funds must be escrowed and remain unwithdrawn until the FSC issues the operating permit; additional statutory operating bond and settlement fund deposits apply under TWSE/TDCC requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At the inaugural board meeting of the Company, duly convened with a quorum of all directors present, it is RESOLVED: First, the Articles of Incorporation are adopted and the subscription of 20,000,000 par-value shares by the founding shareholders is confirmed, paid-in capital being NT$200,000,000 as certified by the CPA's capital-verification report; Second, the registered office is fixed at the Taipei address; Third, the directors appoint [General Manager] as President, [Legal/Compliance Officer] and [Chief Financial Officer] are appointed; Fourth, the Chairman is authorized to file registration with the Department of Commerce, MOEA, and to make all regulatory applications, including the FSC securities-broker operating permit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cross-Strait Investment Screening and Foreign Capital Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議司) - online portal: investaudit.moea.gov.tw
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File prior investment approval for the Taiwan subsidiary as a Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture: submit the JV contract, draft Articles, shareholders' beneficial ownership declarations, and source-of-funds statements. The mainland China shareholder must additionally satisfy the cross-strait review under Article 73 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, triggering a national-security assessment. Upon approval, obtain the Investment Approval Certificate and only thereafter remit capital into the Taiwan account.
required_dossiers: Foreign/Mainland Investment Application Form (IJ-01)
Sino-Foreign JV Agreement and capital schedule
Draft Articles of Incorporation
Board resolution and ID/passport scans of all shareholders
Audited financial statements of the mainland China shareholder
Beneficial ownership declaration and AML/CFT screening questionnaire
Letter of representation authorizing the local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Investment Commission's supplementary-document notice within 30 calendar days; if approval is denied on national-security grounds, restructure the shareholding or apply for special cross-strait securities-sector admission; an administrative appeal may be filed under the Administrative Appeal Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Constitutional Document Execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, MOEA (經濟部商業署) - Company Name and Business Pre-Approval System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Check the proposed English and Chinese company names against the MOEA name registry; reserve the approved name online for up to six months; execute the Articles of Incorporation and minutes of the founding shareholders' meeting; notarize signatures at the Taipei District Court Notary Office or before a licensed attorney for all founding parties.
required_dossiers: Company name pre-approval application
Articles of Incorporation (股份有限公司章程)
Minutes of the founding shareholders' meeting
Written consents of directors and supervisors
Notarization certificate of signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, select an alternative name and re-file; if notarization is queried, cure the signature formalities and resubmit within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Subscription Deposit and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed CPA registered with the FSC and a designated Taipei commercial bank holding the escrow capital account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital account at a commercial bank in Taipei; remit the subscribed NT$200,000,000 from each shareholder's overseas account with the Investment Commission remittance permit; the CPA inspects the bank passbook, subscription ledger, and remittance certificates, then issues the statutory capital-verification report (資本額查核報告).
required_dossiers: Capital remittance permit from the Investment Commission
Bank deposit certificate and passbook entries
Share subscription ledger and payment receipts
CPA capital-verification report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance is flagged by the Foreign Exchange Department of the Central Bank, provide the investment approval certificate to release the funds; if the CPA queries valuation, replace any non-cash assets with cash subscriptions and re-verify; capital must remain escrowed until the FSC permit is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Registration and Issuance of Company Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, MOEA (經濟部商業署) - one-stop company registration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application electronically with the MOEA Company Registration System; attach the Articles, capital-verification report, appointment resolutions, and registered-office lease; pay the statutory registration fee; obtain the Certificate of Company Registration and the uniform tax number in a single transaction.
required_dossiers: MOEA company registration application form
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
CPA capital-verification report
List of directors and supervisors with consents
Registered-office lease agreement and landlord consent
Investment approval certificate from the Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MOEA issues a correction request, cure the deficiency within 15 calendar days per the Companies Act; if the office domicile is challenged, file an amended lease and re-submit; an administrative appeal lies against a refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor and Corporate Seal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (財政部各區國稅局); Taipei City Labor Insurance Bureau, Ministry of Labor (勞動部勞工保險局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete business and tax registration (稅籍登記) to activate the Uniform Invoice Number; register as an employer with labor insurance and pension schemes; file the company seal (印鑑) and responsible-person identity; open the operating current account and lay the groundwork for segregated client accounts.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Company Registration
Business Registration / Uniform Invoice Number application
Registered-office lease agreement
Responsible person ID or ARC
Labor insurance and pension registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau flags the office address, provide the utility bill or notarized lease; if labor registration is incomplete, retroactively establish payroll records and pay premiums within the statutory abatement period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission - Securities and Futures Bureau (金融監督管理委員會證券期貨局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the securities firm establishment application under Article 44 of the Securities and Exchange Act and the Standards Governing the Establishment of Securities Firms; present statutory paid-in capital, the operational plan, internal control and AML/CFT compliance manuals, responsible-person and CCO qualification evidence, and the client-asset segregation and firewall procedures; obtain the FSC operating permit before offering any brokerage service.
required_dossiers: FSC securities-firm license application (Form FSC-SF-01)
Business plan and financial projections
Board-approved internal control, compliance and AML/CFT manuals
Qualification certificates for directors, CCO and responsible persons
CPA capital-verification report and paid-in capital evidence
Articles of Incorporation and MOEA registration certificate
Foreign and cross-strait investment approval certificates
Draft operating rules and client agreement templates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The FSC may request supplementary materials within a fixed period and may extend review by up to 60 days; if refused for insufficient capital or compliance gaps, increase paid-in capital, replace compliance personnel, or narrow the license scope and re-apply; an administrative petition may be filed within 30 days of the refusal decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Exchange Membership, Settlement Deposits and Commencement Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) / Taipei Exchange (TPEx); Taiwan Depository and Clearing Corporation (TDCC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for exchange membership and brokerage trading codes; execute settlement and clearing agreements with TDCC; deposit the statutory operating bond and settlement fund; implement the segregated client account reporting system; file the commencement declaration with the FSC and issue the public notice of business commencement.
required_dossiers: TWSE/TPEx membership application
Settlement and clearing agreements with TDCC
Proof of operating bond deposit
Segregated client assets custody agreement with custodian bank
Operational rules and order-routing testing report
FSC operating permit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If exchange readiness testing is not passed, remediate the order-management and reporting systems and retest; if deposits are deficient, top up the settlement fund; any delay in commencement must be reported to the FSC with a corrected implementation timetable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission - Securities and Futures Bureau (金融監督管理委員會證券期貨局)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Securities Firm Operating Permit (證券商許可證照) under Article 44 of the Securities and Exchange Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, ROC Taiwan (環境部) - successor to the Environmental Protection Administration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Non-industrial office use; no EIA Report or registration required under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act because the licensed activity is a financial services office with no developmental construction or industrial facility
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluent or VOC emission thresholds apply; office sanitary wastewater must meet Taipei City municipal sewer discharge standards under the Water Pollution Control Act; indoor air quality managed per the Indoor Air Quality Act; general waste handled through licensed municipal collection and electronic waste routed to certified recyclers; no regulated air pollutant sources on site.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Equipment Inspection Declaration (消防安全設備檢修申報) and Fire Protection Plan (消防防護計畫) filed with the Taipei City Fire Department; building use permit and structural load verification for the office floors under the Building Act; workplace safety and health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act administered by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Ministry of Labor; post-license site inspection accepted by the FSC within six months of business commencement.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (R.O.C.) – National Taxation Administration; e-service portal: https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw; e-invoice portal: https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident entity must establish a fixed place of business (branch) and file an Application for Registration of Profit-Seeking Enterprise with the regional National Taxation Bureau before commencing taxable operations. Submit the joint-venture contract, approval/licence evidence, power of attorney appointing a local tax representative, and lease or place-of-business proof. The Administration verifies the documents and issues the 8-digit Uniform Invoice Number (GUI) for VAT and income tax purposes. If no fixed place of business exists, the foreign entity may obtain a TIN through withholding-based registration and must appoint a withholding agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election exists in Taiwan. Corporate income tax applies at the entity level under the Income Tax Act. A profit-seeking enterprise may elect, subject to NTA approval, to carry forward net losses against future income for up to 10 years, but this does not create pass-through treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax (VAT-based Business Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold applies to businesses with a fixed place of business in Taiwan; registration is mandatory before taxable activity begins. For a non-resident seller of cross-border electronic services to Taiwan resident individuals, VAT registration is required only if annual taxable turnover exceeds NT$480,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan mandates Uniform Invoices (統一發票) for all taxable businesses. Certified e-invoices must be transmitted to the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Platform through an approved API or the Cloud Invoice APP within 48 hours of issuance. Real-time government fiscal clearance is not used; instead, the system applies digital encryption, GUI embedment, and QR-code verification. Securities brokerage commission income must be invoiced using the prescribed category for financial services and retained in electronic records for inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to export services sold in Taiwan for use outside Taiwan. For offshore securities brokerage, zero-rating requires: (i) the client is a non-resident juridical person or foreign individual, (ii) the trades are executed on an offshore exchange or otherwise the brokerage service is fully performed outside Taiwan, and (iii) the commission is invoiced in foreign currency and received by inward remittance. The service contract, trade confirmations, and exchange settlement records must demonstrate foreign consumption and the non-resident status of the principal.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (required only if the brokerage transaction involves physical securities certificates or goods; otherwise N/A)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (same dual-purpose limitation used as evidence when goods are embedded)

Inward Remittance Certificate and Foreign Exchange Settlement Record for the commission, supplemented by the brokerage contract, issuer trade confirmations, and the client's non-resident certification
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau may audit zero-rated export brokerage claims within 4 statutory limitation years (extended to 7 years in fraud cases). If the zero-rating claim is denied or fraudulent, the taxpayer must repay the evaded tax, plus interest, and is subject to an administrative penalty of one to five times the evaded amount. Deliberate fraud or evasion is additionally referred for criminal prosecution under Article 41 of the Tax Evasion Act, carrying imprisonment of up to five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) for foreign-exchange administration, together with the Financial Supervisory Commission for securities, banking, anti-money-laundering, customer-asset and licensed-brokerage supervision. Cross-Strait investment and remittance matters may also require review or approval by the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs under applicable Taiwan regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The New Taiwan dollar is generally convertible for legitimate current-account transactions, including documented trade payments, service fees, salaries, taxes, interest and dividends. Capital-account transactions, foreign direct investment, capital injections, intercompany loans, securities investments and repatriation of capital remain subject to foreign-exchange declarations, bank documentary review, applicable annual thresholds, and any required regulatory approval. A Taiwan securities-brokerage vehicle must separately satisfy Financial Supervisory Commission licensing, capital, client-asset segregation, prudential, reporting and anti-money-laundering requirements. Dividend and profit remittances normally require audited financial statements, shareholder and corporate approvals, tax clearance or withholding-tax evidence, evidence of distributable profits, and confirmation that regulatory capital and statutory reserves remain compliant. A PRC-origin shareholder or control structure may trigger additional Cross-Strait restrictions, beneficial-owner review and Investment Commission requirements. Offshore digital payment institutions cannot be used to bypass Taiwan banking, foreign-exchange, securities, client-money or AML controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Taiwan does not generally impose a universal mandatory conversion ratio requiring all export proceeds to be surrendered into New Taiwan dollars. Exporters must maintain appropriate customs, commercial-invoice, shipping, banking and foreign-exchange records, and banks report or process qualifying foreign-exchange transactions under Central Bank rules. Foreign-currency export receipts may generally be retained in permitted foreign-currency accounts, subject to transaction documentation and bank controls. No single universal statutory conversion deadline applies to every export transaction; the applicable timing depends on the underlying trade, collection method, bank reporting category and current Central Bank rules. The proposed entity is a securities brokerage business rather than an exporter, so export-proceeds rules should not be treated as authority for receiving client securities funds or brokerage revenue.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for core treasury, client-money and securities-settlement functions. An offshore electronic-money institution or digital wallet may support limited corporate operating payments only where its licensing, Taiwan payment-service permissions, correspondent-bank arrangements, transaction limits and AML controls permit. It cannot lawfully replace a Taiwan bank account for regulated brokerage client assets, segregated money, capital injection, securities settlement, foreign-exchange reporting or licensed financial intermediation. Visa and Mastercard acquiring or payout arrangements require licensed acquiring, payment, merchant, consumer-protection, chargeback and AML structures and do not authorize securities brokerage.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote preliminary onboarding may be available, but a regulated, foreign-owned, high-risk securities-brokerage applicant should expect enhanced due diligence, notarized or apostilled corporate documents, certified translations, local authorized representatives, Taiwan business registration evidence, licensing evidence, source-of-funds verification and at least one live video or in-person interview. Directors need not universally appear physically under every bank policy, but the bank may require physical attendance by directors, the legal representative, authorized signatories or the Taiwan-resident responsible officer. Final account activation, foreign-exchange permissions and transaction-limit approval remain bank-specific.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Retail securities brokerage, CFDs, derivatives or other high-risk financial activities without a clearly verified Taiwan license, permitted business scope and regulatory capital plan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Financial Supervisory Commission licensing or approval documents; company registration; articles of incorporation; business plan; product and jurisdiction matrix; client-asset segregation policy; prudential-capital calculation; compliance officer appointment; internal-control and AML program; regulatory correspondence; audited financial projections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership, nominee shareholders, layered entities, opaque trusts, bearer-like arrangements or a PRC-linked ownership or control chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership chart to natural persons; certified registers; constitutional documents for every intermediate entity; passports and residential evidence for ultimate beneficial owners and controllers; director and authorized-signatory data; shareholder agreements; control-rights analysis; Cross-Strait and Investment Commission approvals or legal opinions where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection or operating funds originating from mainland China, offshore intermediaries, crypto platforms, private investment vehicles or unrelated third parties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved investment and remittance documents; bank-origin statements; audited financial statements; tax returns; source-of-wealth declarations; board resolutions; subscription agreement; remittance purpose; intercompany-loan agreement if applicable; sanctions and adverse-media screening; evidence of regulatory permission for the funding route.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of personal accounts, payment aggregators, offshore EMIs or omnibus wallets for customer funds or brokerage receipts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank-approved funds-flow diagram; segregated client-money account structure; reconciliation policy; payment-service provider licenses; correspondent agreements; customer-money safeguarding opinion; transaction monitoring rules; prohibition on commingling; independent controls testing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected payments from or to sanctioned, restricted, high-risk or weakly regulated jurisdictions, including opaque crypto-related counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Country and counterparty risk policy; sanctions-screening methodology; prohibited-jurisdiction list; transaction-purpose controls; enhanced due-diligence files; contractual representations; blockchain analytics where relevant; escalation and suspicious-transaction reporting procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume retail card activity, chargebacks, CFDs, leveraged products or rapid in-and-out flows inconsistent with stated revenue forecasts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year transaction forecast; client segmentation; expected average ticket and geographic distribution; card-acquiring agreement; chargeback controls; withdrawal policy; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth procedures; transaction-monitoring scenarios; liquidity and stress-testing evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient distinction between proprietary treasury funds, customer assets, margin collateral, settlement funds and revenue.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Account architecture; legal-entity and ledger mapping; daily reconciliation procedures; custody and settlement agreements; client-asset trust or segregation analysis; authorized-payment matrix; independent audit arrangements; financial-statement presentation policy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route capital through a Taiwan licensed bank into the designated account specified for foreign investment or capital injection. Obtain any required Investment Commission, company-registration and foreign-exchange approvals before remittance. The remitter name must match the approved investor or an expressly permitted funding entity; third-party remittances should be avoided. Use the bank's accurate purpose code for equity investment, capital increase or approved shareholder loan, supported by the subscription agreement, board and shareholder resolutions, approval letters, ownership chart and source-of-funds evidence. The receiving bank should verify investor identity, beneficial ownership, sanctions status, remittance purpose, amount, currency and capital-registration requirements before conversion or release. Record the original foreign currency, converted New Taiwan dollar amount, exchange rate, bank advice, accounting entry and capital-registration evidence. For PRC-origin funds, obtain specialist Cross-Strait and Taiwan investment advice before any transfer because the remittance may be prohibited or approval-dependent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use Taiwan bank SWIFT transfers, normally SWIFT MT103 or its ISO 20022 successor equivalent, for approved corporate payments. Each payment should identify the contracting party, invoice, underlying service or trade, beneficiary account, economic purpose, currency, tax treatment and supporting documents. Commercial letters of credit may be issued or advised through a Taiwan bank for genuine merchandise transactions, subject to bank credit approval, UCP 600 documentation and sanctions screening. For brokerage operations, client deposits and withdrawals should use segregated, pre-approved client-money rails rather than trade-payment instruments. Securities settlements should use the licensed broker, custodian, clearing member and applicable Taiwan securities-clearing infrastructure; customer funds must not be routed through unrelated offshore accounts. Establish dual authorization, maker-checker controls, beneficiary verification, callback procedures, daily reconciliation, payment-limit controls and exception escalation for all outbound wires.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with a Taiwan licensed bank, supported by an underlying documented exposure and within the bank's approved corporate-hedging limits.

Non-deliverable forwards only where offered by an appropriately licensed Taiwan bank, legally available for the relevant currency, and supported by documented exposure, suitability controls and applicable Central Bank requirements.

Currency swaps or cross-currency swaps with a Taiwan licensed bank for genuine funding, liquidity or foreign-currency exposure management, subject to documentation, credit limits, accounting treatment and regulatory reporting.

Foreign-exchange options or collars may be considered only after bank suitability review, board-approved risk limits, accounting analysis and confirmation that the instrument is permissible for the entity and underlying exposure.

Prohibited or high-risk practices include speculative leveraged FX trading, unapproved derivatives platforms, crypto-settled hedges, informal netting, undisclosed related-party trades and hedges lacking a documented commercial exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting and Approval of Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' General Meeting; minutes recorded in Minute Book and accessible by MOEA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the AGM subjects the company to administrative fines under the Company Act; sustained failure after two consecutive years may result in administrative strike-off of the company by MOEA.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Audited Annual Financial Statements with MOEA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) - Company Registration and Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by June 30, following AGM approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty under Company Act Articles 20 and 380 (NT$50,000–NT$250,000) and a prescribed rectification notice; two consecutive years of default may trigger administrative dissolution or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance - National Taxation Bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 to May 31 in the following calendar year; extended to June 30 where a CPA audited financial report is mandatory
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 3% of unpaid tax for each 30-day period, capped at 10%; persistent non-filing allows the tax authority to issue a tax assessment and enforce collection through administrative garnishment and company suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Report and Regulatory Compliance Report to FSC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) - Securities and Futures Bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine, business restriction, and suspension of securities license; continuous violation may lead to revocation of the securities brokerage license and forced liquidation under the Securities Services Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Report for the Mainland China Investor (JV Shareholding Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOEA - Investment Commission (Domestic and Foreign Investment Review)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by June 30, in accordance with the investment approval condition
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of NT$30,000–NT$1,500,000 under the Investment Regulations; failure to file may suspend conversion or repatriation rights of the Chinese investor and may eventually result in administrative revocation of the JV investment approval.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent CPA audit under Company Act if paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million. Separately, as a licensed securities broker under the Securities Services Act, the company is per se subject to mandatory CPA audit irrespective of capital size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission and MOEA; ROC GAAP is not acceptable for securities broker regulatory filings. Financial statements are maintained in Taiwan dollars.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no stand-alone UBO annual filing in Taiwan, but the securities broker must keep its beneficial ownership register current. Any share transfer or UBO change ≥25% must be recorded in the share registry and reported to MOEA within 15 days. Under the Money Laundering Control Act, the AML compliance program must re-confirm the register to the FSC at least once per calendar year as part of the annual AML review.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,000 - 5,000 per year for registered office and company secretary/AML officer support in Taipei
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 15,000 - 40,000 per year for certified independent audit of a regulated securities broker

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% on taxable income exceeding NT$120,000; 12% reduced rate applies to taxable income of NT$120,000 or less, with the 'tax shall not exceed the excess over NT$120,000' anti-notching rule (Income Tax Act Art. 5).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sectoral tax holiday for securities brokerage. A 5% surtax is imposed on undistributed after-tax earnings, creating an incentive for timely dividend distribution. Preferential deductions include R&D investment tax credits, employee training credits, and the statutory 12% reduced rate for low-margin enterprises; tax-exempt income includes listed-share securities transaction gains subject to the alternative minimum tax and retained-earnings surtax.
